alignment: sample_id=global_index=canonical torchvision CIFAR-100 train position; class_index independently checked against local labels; 100 classes x 500 samples
configuration: batch_size=64; t=500; seed=0; shuffle=False; four indexed shards; score stored as float32.
preprocessing: CIFAR-100 ToTensor, resize/crop to 256 as configured by the local scorer, VAE latent scaling, posterior mode, sequential train order.
